name: scala-cli

scripts.checksum_source: locally-pinned upstream script at fixed commit

resources.checksum_source: locally-computed-pin from official HTTPS release; not independently authenticated publisher checksum

notes: Native Scala CLI executable only. JDK, Scala compiler artifacts, Bloop and Maven dependencies are not included. Preserves official install-home operation with explicit bin-dir options; local functional scope is directory/configuration discovery.
Upstream installer is fetched at build time from a pinned commit. No upstream script snapshot is vendored in the skill.

The separate scala-cli-packages installer repository has no established license grant. Complete script is fetched at build time; recipe includes minimal anchors only, not a grant covering redistribution of generated bundles.
